page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 310.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.46 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage and relies on external network storage, operating on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in large language model inference tasks. For a small 135M model, prompt processing reaches 9711.08 tokens per second and text generation achieves 456.51 tokens per second. With a medium 7B model, prompt processing registers at 2509.43 tokens per second and text generation at 90.44 tokens per second, both placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench image processing, and Passmark CPU encryption tests also show strong performance in the top 25%. Other standard compute, memory bandwidth, and database benchmarks generally fall within the average range.

Given the dedicated 48-core Intel Xeon CPU and the integrated NVIDIA A10 GPU, this instance offers a balanced resource density for GPU-accelerated workloads without the overhead of local NVMe storage. The absence of bundled local storage represents a tradeoff, requiring network-attached storage for data persistence. This configuration is highly suitable for medium-scale AI inference, image processing, cryptographic workloads, and parallel decompression tasks.
